title: From a well-known musician to living in exile: Kyar Pauk on fleeing Myanmar
summary: Having worked as a singer-songwriter and visual artist in Myanmar, Kyar Pauk used his voice to speak out against the military junta that led a coup in 2021. Speaking to FRANCE 24, he describes how, when he learned that military authorities wanted his arrest, he was able to escape through the jungle in Thailand.
